title: @bsh/degent-telegram-gate environment
description: Environment variables read by src/config.ts. Secrets (x-secret) come from the secret store, never from the repo. Variables marked x-required-unless-regtest may be omitted only when NETWORK=regtest (dev: in-memory stores, a Telegram adapter that sends nothing, an empty holder registry, dev link secret and session key).

NETWORK.description: Bitcoin network of the holders' addresses and of the SIWB challenges.

WEB_BASE_URL.description: Origin of the site serving /verify (e.g. https://degent.club). The link is <WEB_BASE_URL>/verify?tg=<token>; also the only CORS origin and, by default, the SIWB domain. https off regtest.

SIWB_DOMAIN.description: Optional; must equal the host of WEB_BASE_URL (the page the wallet signs on).

HOLDERS_CHAT_ID.description: The private holders group id, e.g. -1001234567890.

TELEGRAM_GATE_BOT_TOKEN.description: A dedicated BotFather token (admin of the group with 'Invite users via link' and 'Ban users').

MINT_API_URL.description: degent-mint base URL; the gate calls GET /v1/register/holder/{address}.

GATE_LINK_SECRET.description: HMAC key for the /verify link tokens. openssl rand -hex 32.

SESSION_KEY.description: Ed25519 secret key (hex) for operator sessions (GET /gate/stats).

ADMIN_ADDRESSES.description: Comma-separated addresses allowed to sign in as operators.

DATABASE_PATH.description: node:sqlite file (members, used links, SIWB nonces).

HOLDER_CACHE_SECONDS.description: Register answer cache (verification and re-checks bypass it).

RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE.description: POSTs per client IP per minute.

TRUST_PROXY.description: Use the first X-Forwarded-For hop as the client IP.
